            now=1000.0,
        )
        assert result == pytest.approx(0.0), f"Expected 0.0, got {result}"

        """Single signal in window yields 1/saturation."""
        now = 1000.0
        history = [_make_signal(timestamp=now - 10.0)]

        history = _make_signals_in_window(count=200, now=now, window_seconds=300.0)
        result = compute_signal_frequency(
            signal_history=history,
            window_seconds=300.0,

            signal_history=history,
            window_seconds=300.0,
            frequency_saturation=100.0,

        result = compute_signal_frequency(
            signal_history=history,

    def test_happy_path_increasing_volume(self):
        """More recent signals than older signals produces velocity > 0.5."""
        now = 1000.0
        window = 300.0
        midpoint = now - window / 2.0

        # 2 signals in older half, 8 in recent half
        older = [_make_signal(timestamp=midpoint - 50.0), _make_signal(timestamp=midpoint - 100.0)]
        recent = [_make_signal(timestamp=midpoint + 10.0 * i) for i in range(1, 9)]
        history = older + recent

        result = compute_engagement_velocity(
            signal_history=history,
            window_seconds=window,
            now=now,
        )
        assert result > 0.5, f"Increasing volume should yield > 0.5, got {result}"
        assert 0.0 <= result <= 1.0, f"Result {result} not in [0.0, 1.0]"

            now=1000.0,

        assert result == pytest.approx(0.0), f"Expected 0.0 for empty history, got {result}"

        now = 1000.0
